versions.changelog:
Initial release for converting Envato comments into structured tasks for Google Sheets.

- Analyzes ThemeForest/CodeCanyon comments and classifies them by type and priority.
- Extracts technical details and formats output as a JSON object suitable for Google Sheets.
- Supports classification types: bug, feature_request, support_question, update_required, refund_risk, positive_feedback.
- Useful for automating support workflows, tracking product health, and planning updates.
